HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

2. Which response best shows understanding of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette:.
   B. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use General Etiquette: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say General Etiquette: has no place in daily life.

4. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

5. Which response best shows understanding of Myself [? (1 mark)
   A. Use Myself [ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Myself [ has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Myself [ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself [.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

7. Which response best shows understanding of Basic Prayers? (1 mark)
   A. Use Basic Prayers to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Basic Prayers.
   C. Apply the teaching of Basic Prayers with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Basic Prayers has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   B. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities Of Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities Of Enlightened Beings.
   B. Use Qualities Of Enlightened Beings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Qualities Of Enlightened Beings has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Qualities Of Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
